title: MOTNGRFX — 24 GB (Gemma 4 31B)
note: No request needed: Gemma 4 31B invents the words, scene, music style, look and shots mode (unique against the earlier pieces in `previous`), then the whole fusion_design_qwen pipeline makes the piece. Length and seed are the only inputs. Footage route: three layers per shot - a CLEAN plain image-to-video clip (the subject, no type), the Alpha-Gen matte cut from it, and a text-rendered background (LTX union-control video-to-video of the clean clip, only for shots with a type control guide > 0); compose puts the type between the background and the clean subject. LLM arm: Gemma 4 31B QAT Q4_K_XL (Apache-2.0, llama.cpp GGUF, n_gpu_layers -1, KV q8_0) instead of design_llm_8b 4-bit; see tools/app/llm_arms.py. 24 GB tier (NOT MEASURED), Quality defaults to Final = the draft tier (576x1024 single-stage); Preview = the held stills; n_ctx 32768 on every LLM call: 24 GB: draft 576x1024 single-stage, LTX int8 (20 GB) resident at draft size, gemma int8 resident, MOSS bf16 + bf16 encoder resident one at a time.

fields.hint: Preview (still): each shot's own still held instead of LTX video (type, 3D cuts, music and compose are real) - the quick look at the design; Final: the LTX render (still_preview.APP_FINAL_TIER) plus the Real-ESRGAN 1080 upscale; hidden value draft540 (what the page sends since v20) = the same LTX render WITHOUT the upscale; tools/app/upgrade_still.py renders a Preview as Final with the same stills and design.
